description.en: Pure, uncomplicated sweetness. It simply exists to bring a soft, patient presence into your day. Every time you mindlessly look down, enjoy that exact, comforting feeling of a happy little daydream—the kind where you share a quiet plate of mochi over a warm cup of tea. Just a little bit of joy to carry around with you.
